meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取主机可用资源快照，辅助运行前判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常跑吃资源的大任务，想知道本机是否扛得住。
copy.tagline_en: Get a snapshot of your machine's available resources before launching a task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run resource-heavy tasks and want to know whether your machine can handle them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在跑耗资源的计算任务前会先运行检测脚本,把 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘情况写进当前目录的 .claude_resources.json,并给出并行、内存、GPU 三方面的策略建议,再据此决定用什么方式算。
howto.when: 当你提出要做资源敏感的本地任务时触发,比如分析大数据集、训练模型、并行处理大量文件等;原文还建议在项目开始前主动运行。

say.text: 先检测一下这台机器的资源,再决定怎么分析
帮我看看有没有 GPU 可用,训练该用哪个后端
say.note: 输出可用后端与建议库

say.text: 这个 50GB 数据集,先看内存和磁盘够不够
say.note: 给出分块或落盘策略建议

howto.what_en: Before resource-heavy local workloads, Claude runs a detection script that writes CPU, GPU, memory, and disk info to .claude_resources.json in the working directory, plus parallel, memory, and GPU strategy recommendations that inform the compute approach.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a resource-sensitive local task, such as analyzing a large dataset, training a model, or processing many files in parallel; the doc also suggests running it at project start.

say_en.text: Check this machine's resources first, then decide how to analyze.
See if a GPU is available and which backend to train with.
For this 50GB dataset, check memory and disk first.
